data.name: Silence of Dawn
data.detailed_description:
Silence of Dawn is a third-person horror survival game set inside a mysterious mansion hiding a disturbing secret.

After discovering a hidden laboratory beneath the mansion, Elena Ward becomes trapped inside a nightmare. Strange experiments have given birth to terrifying creatures that now roam the halls.

As Elena explores deeper into the mansion, she uncovers fragments of a secret experiment that should never have existed.

The deeper she goes, the more dangerous the mansion becomes.

Search for clues, unlock hidden areas, and piece together the truth while avoiding the creatures that hunt you in the darkness.

Survive the night.

Escape the mansion.

Reveal the truth behind the experiment.

Key Features

Third-Person Survival Horror

Experience the nightmare from a third-person perspective as you guide Elena through the dark halls of the mansion.

Explore a Mysterious Mansion

Search abandoned rooms, hidden laboratories, and secret passages filled with clues.

Evade Deadly Creatures

The mansion is not empty. Creatures born from forbidden experiments stalk the corridors.

Uncover the Truth

Collect documents and hidden clues to reveal what really happened inside the laboratory.

Atmospheric Horror

Dark environments, eerie sound design, and tense exploration create a constant feeling of danger.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 Ghz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Gtx 750/ AMD Radeon 6870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.5 Ghz or faster
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Gtx 950/ AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 12 or higher
  • Processor: Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS 12 or higher
  • Processor: Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
